summary: The sandbox profile denies the specified WindowServer and CARenderServer lookups, retries directly only when stderr contains `sandbox_apply`, and preserves exact PNG and manifest comparisons. The reported Debug build and all 79 CTests pass, including native-shell-goldens. The base-to-candidate diff changes only the verifier and active work order, and the frozen work-order validation, ledger validation, and diff checks pass. Pending STATE/LEDGER acceptance status and the terminal preflight-only ledger history do not count against this review.
